annotations.title: Transcribe a podcast or media link

description: Transcribe a public podcast or media link. Use it for Apple Podcasts, Spotify, TikTok, Instagram Reel/Post, RSS feed links, and direct audio/video URLs (ending in .mp3, .m4a, .wav, .mp4, .webm and similar); YouTube links use transcriptlab_get_transcript. Podcasts, Instagram and media files are transcribed with speech-to-text (billed per audio minute). TikTok links read their built-in captions only (1 credit); if a TikTok has none, tell the user and ask before retrying with engine=stt — never switch to speech-to-text silently. Returns a media_id: poll transcriptlab_get_speech_transcript with it, waiting a few seconds between tries and stopping after about ten.

chunks.description: Split transcript into o200k_base token chunks (true for defaults, or { max_tokens, overlap_tokens }).

diarize.description: Label speakers; defaults to false. Implies tier=premium.

engine.description: TikTok links default to captions (built-in captions only, never speech-to-text); other links default to stt, as they have no captions. Pass stt or auto (captions; speech-to-text when they are confirmed absent) for a TikTok only when the user opted into speech-to-text, which is billed per audio minute.

lang.description: Optional ISO 639-1 spoken language hint (e.g. "ar", "en", "es"); omit or "auto" to auto-detect.

markdown.description: Include timestamped Markdown rendering on cached/completed JSON responses.

tier.description: Speech model tier; defaults to auto (normal when available).

url.description: Public https URL of a podcast episode/show, RSS feed, TikTok video, Instagram Reel/Post, or audio/video file.
